```{r}
## load IATA travel volumes for past 24 months
filepath <- paste(save_path_rad, "eth_arrivals.rds", sep = "/")
eth_arrivals <- readRDS(filepath)
```

```{r}
## aggregate to monthly data
eth_monthly <- eth_arrivals |> 
  group_by(year, month, ym, date) |> 
  summarise(volume = sum(npass))

## flag months of interest
eth_monthly <- eth_monthly |> 
  mutate(
    period = if_else(month == "09" | month == "10", 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
## fill palette
my_fills <- scico::scico(2, palette = "lipari", begin = 0.2, end = 0.8)
ymax <- plyr::round_any(max(eth_monthly$volume), 100, f = ceiling)

## plot
eth_monthly |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = volume)) +
  geom_col(fill = my_fills[1]) +
  #scale_fill_manual(values = my_fills) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "2 months" , date_labels = "%b-%y") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, ymax, 200)) +
  labs(
    x = "Month",
    y = "Travel volume"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
  )
```

```{r}
eth_monthly |> 
  select(year, month, volume) |> 
  kable() 
```

```{r}
## mean monthly travel volume
eth_monthly |> 
  select(year, month, volume) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarise(monthly_mean = mean(volume))
```

```{r}
## travel volume by source airport
eth_monthly_airport <- eth_arrivals |> 
  group_by(orig, year, month, ym, date) |> 
  summarise(volume = sum(npass))

eth_monthly_airport |> 
  pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ym, year ,month, date), names_from = orig, values_from = volume)
```

```{r}
## percentage share of travel from each airport
eth_airport_percents <- eth_monthly_airport |> 
  group_by(orig) |> 
  summarise(volume = sum(volume)) |> 
  mutate(
    p = volume / sum(volume)
  )

## save
#saveRDS(eth_airport_percents, file = here("output", "eth_airport_percents.rds"))
```
